excerpt.zh: 在环形世界施工管事出色的领导下，我们能将建造流程最优化，显著加快了建造速度。
excerpt.en: Under the skillful leadership of the ring world construction manager, we have been able to optimize the construction workflow, increasing the build speed significantly.

scope.zh: 在建环形世界的随机施工事件三选一。
scope.en: Three random incidents while a Ring World is being built.

texts.zh: 在环形世界施工管事出色的领导下，我们能将建造流程最优化，显著加快了建造速度。
texts.en: Under the skillful leadership of the ring world construction manager, we have been able to optimize the construction workflow, increasing the build speed significantly.

texts.zh: 我们在环形世界上的建造团队发现了一大片矿藏着床于极硬的岩石中，而矿藏在建造过程中会碎裂。虽然易受影响，样本足以说明矿藏值得我们停下环形世界的建造来开发。
texts.en: The construction team on the ring world has discovered a large deposit of minerals embedded in extremely porous stone, that will disintegrate during the build process. Though sensitive, the sample could be valuable enough that it would be worth our while to halt construction to extract it.

texts.zh: 自从环形世界的建造工作开始后，一小部分工人失踪了。似乎他们乘坐着无数运输船中的一艘，未通知他们的上级就离开了，我们正在开展调查以寻求他们的去向。不幸的是他们未经允许的离开显著拖延了建造。
texts.en: Since construction on the ring world began, a number of workers have gone missing. Though it's likely they've simply left with one of the many transports without notifying their supervisors, we are launching an investigation into their whereabouts. Sadly their unexpected departure has delayed construction slightly.

texts.zh: 随着替补工人的到来，环形世界的建造工作终于回归正轨了。可惜的是我们还没有找到失踪的工人们，他们的家人已经得到通知了。
texts.en: With the arrival of replacement workers, construction on the ring world is finally back on track. Regrettably we have still not been able to locate the missing workers, whose families have now been notified.

label.zh: 我们的思念与他们同在。

texts.zh:
似乎我们用来建造环形世界的一颗星球并不像我们开始想的那样不可居住，一种看起来无害，但之前未知的物种——昵称为“可可”的巨型太空蠕虫——被我们用它们母星的碎片带到了环形世界。

由于它们那毛绒绒的毛皮和温顺的习性，这些可爱的生物很快就成为了工人们的最爱，毕竟他们远离家人，常年孤独地呆在这，尤其是处在有工人失踪的当下。

我们可以让这些生物继续和平生活在这儿，或者净化它们，显著延缓建造进度。
texts.en:
It appears as if one of the planets used to construct the ring world was not as uninhabited as we first thought. A seemingly harmless, but previously unknown species of giant space worm, nicknamed "Coo-coo" after its call, has been transferred to the ring world with fragments from its homeworld.

With their fuzzy fur and gentle demeanor, the endearing creatures have become an instant favorite with the workers, who are far away from their families and often very lonely. Especially in the light of their missing co-workers.

We could allow the creatures to continue their lives in peace, or purge them, delaying construction slightly.

texts.zh:
我们负责清除巨型蠕虫“可可”的灭绝小队遭到了建造工人的暴力阻挠。

一个年轻人试图铤而走险，尝试藏住它的宠物。他到达了足够远离建造点的地方，掉入了一个新近挖掘的地下网络通道，在那他撞见几只“可可”在用失踪工人的残留物喂食。他的宠物试图向他喷射消化液，但他还是死里逃生。他立刻通知了灭绝小队，小队迅速消灭了这些肉食类蠕虫。

“可可”的本性也就此揭露。
texts.en:
The extermination team's efforts to rid the ring world of the giant space worms known as Coo-coos, have been aggravated by violent protests from the construction workers.

In a desperate attempt to hide his pet, one young man even ventured far enough outside the build site, that he stumbled upon a subterranean network of freshly dug tunnels, where he caught several Coo-coos feeding off the remains of his missing co-workers. After narrowly escaping from his beloved pet, as it tried to spray him with digestive fluids, he alerted the extermination team, which has made short work of the carnivorous worms.

And so the true nature of the Coo-coo has finally been revealed.

label.en: What a grisly turn of events.

texts.zh:
出乎所有人的意料，环形世界爆发了一场彩色大喷发，成千上万的蠕虫——或者幼虫，现在看起来是的——蜕变为了蝴蝶。似乎这样的变化是因为大气层的产生而出现的。

不过狂欢马上就停止了。因为我们发现了一个地下通道网络，在通道里我们发现“可可”在用我们失踪工人的遗体进食。

直到这些生物被灭绝前，建造工作将暂停，不过我们预计工作将很快完成，因为工人们极度愤慨，“可可”的本性也就此揭露。
texts.en:
To everyone's amazement, the ring world has erupted into a flurry of color as thousands of space worms, or as it seems, larvae, are transforming into butterflies. Likely the change has been brought on by the generation of an atmosphere.

Unfortunately, celebrations have been cut short by the discovery of a subterranean network of tunnels, in which Coo-coos were caught feeding off the remains of several missing workers.

Construction has been halted till the creatures have been exterminated, but we expect swift results as the workers are highly motivated. The true nature of the Coo-coo has been revealed.

summary.text:
# 环形世界施工意外 / Ring World construction incidents

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories

## 如何开始 How it starts

隐藏事件 utopia.20（MTTH 3600 天，megastructure_events_1.txt:417-460）：本国有一个正在升级的环形世界（ring_world_2，剩余升级天数 > 200），且未发生过（event_utopia_20 标记）。
Hidden utopia.20 (MTTH 3600 days, lines 417-460): you own a Ring World at stage 2 that is still upgrading with more than 200 days left; once per country.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

随机三选一（权重 30/30/30，机械帝国或机械物种使第三项为0）：
One of three at random (30/30/30; zero for the third if machine empire or mechanical species):
- utopia.21 加快施工：环形世界获得建造速度修正。 Build-speed boost.
- utopia.22 矿藏：选a停工20天并获得 500 矿物，或选b不理会。 Halt 20 days for 500 minerals (a), or ignore (b).
- utopia.27 失踪的工人：施工放慢30天；30天后 utopia.28；20天后 utopia.23 环形世界宠物；a 停工30天，30天后 utopia.26；b 30天后 utopia.25 并停工20天。
  Missing workers: slower build 30 days; 28 after 30 days; 23 after 20 more; (a) halts 30 days then 26; (b) 25 after 30 days with a 20-day halt.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 三个入口互斥（random_list）。 The three entries are exclusive.
- 27 之后的链条无随机，只有 23 的选项分叉 26 / 25。 After 27 there is no more randomness; only 23's options fork 26 / 25.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 机械帝国/机械物种不会遇到 27。 Machine empires / mechanical species never get 27.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/megastructure_events_1.txt
- 已核对 Checked：utopia.20-28 的触发、random_list 权重及延迟（lines 417-640）。编译树正确。
  Compiled tree and weights verified.
- 本故事发生在“环形世界”（见该故事）建造期间，但由独立的隐藏事件触发，不是建造阶段事件的后续。
  It happens during Ring World construction (see 'Ring World') but is triggered by its own hidden event, not by a stage event.
